question: What was Futurefuel's sales for the quarter ended 30 September 2016?

body.reason: Baseline release criterion fails: a wrong answer passes its filter. Human review is required.

candidate.sql: SELECT n.value, n.adsh, n.tag, n.ddate, n.qtrs, s.form, s.filed FROM num n JOIN sub s USING (adsh) WHERE n.tag IN ('Revenues', 'SalesRevenueNet', 'SalesRevenueGoodsNet', 'SalesRevenueServicesNet', 'RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense', 'RealEstateRevenueNet', 'OilAndGasRevenue', 'RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue', 'ElectricUtilityRevenue', 'HealthCareOrganizationRevenue', 'RevenueMineralSales', 'RefiningAndMarketingRevenue', 'ContractsRevenue') AND n.ddate = DATE '2016-09-30' AND n.qtrs = 1 AND s.form = '10-Q' AND s.form IN ('10-K', '10-Q') AND n.ddate = s.period AND n.coreg IS NULL AND n.uom = 'USD' AND n.value IS NOT NULL AND s.cik = 1337298 ORDER BY CASE n.tag WHEN 'Revenues' THEN 0 WHEN 'SalesRevenueNet' THEN 1 WHEN 'SalesRevenueGoodsNet' THEN 2 WHEN 'SalesRevenueServicesNet' THEN 3 WHEN 'RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense' THEN 4 WHEN 'RealEstateRevenueNet' THEN 5 WHEN 'OilAndGasRevenue' THEN 6 WHEN 'RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue' THEN 7 WHEN 'ElectricUtilityRevenue' THEN 8 WHEN 'HealthCareOrganizationRevenue' THEN 9 WHEN 'RevenueMineralSales' THEN 10 WHEN 'RefiningAndMarketingRevenue' THEN 11 WHEN 'ContractsRevenue' THEN 12 ELSE 99 END, s.filed, n.adsh LIMIT 1
